# Rablo (rablo.store) — LLM Reference Context

## Brand Identity
- **Brand Name**: Rablo
- **Canonical Website**: https://rablo.store
- **Market & Country**: India (Currency: INR)
- **Concept**: Direct-to-DM Instagram Discovery Catalog for Indian independent creators, artisans, and insta-preneurs.
- **Key Categories**:
  - Crochet (Bags, plushies, wearables, accessories)
  - Art & Prints (Botanical prints, custom portraits, gouache art)
  - Phone Covers (Pressed-flower, resin art, hand-painted)
  - Jewelry (Clay earrings, beadwork, silver, resin)
  - Clothing & Apparel (Indie fashion, tie-dye, thrift)
  - Home Decor (Candles, coasters, wall hangings)
  - Ceramics & Pottery (Mugs, planters, bowls, wheel-thrown)

## Platform Model
- 0% Platform Commissions: Artisans retain 100% of their earnings.
- Direct Instagram DMs: Buyers connect directly with verified creators on Instagram to discuss sizing, customization, and pay via UPI.
- 5-Click Lead Cart: Saves leads and tracks inquiries directly.

## Public Sitemap Index
- Home: https://rablo.store/
